title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #11

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does Lord Narsimha look like? (1 mark)
   A. A snake
   B. A man's body with a lion's head and claws
   C. A bird
   D. A fish

2. What should you do when you join a religious activity of another faith? (1 mark)
   A. Make noise
   B. Listen carefully and behave politely
   C. Laugh at it
   D. Refuse to sit

3. Which of these is a Kenyan water body mentioned in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. River Beas
   B. Lake Victoria
   C. River Ganga
   D. River Rijubalika

4. Which goddess is Saraswati? (1 mark)
   A. Goddess of war
   B. Goddess of knowledge and learning
   C. Goddess of the river Ganga
   D. Goddess of fire

5. Which medical use of Tulsi is mentioned in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. A cloth
   B. A tool for digging
   C. A fuel for cars
   D. Tea for coughs and colds

6. Why is yoga best done with an expert? (1 mark)
   A. To finish faster
   B. To be noisy
   C. So no one else can join
   D. To avoid strain from wrong posture

7. Tulsi leaves are offered to which gods? (1 mark)
   A. Lord Vishnu and Lord Krishna
   B. Lord Mahavir
   C. Guru Nanak
   D. Lord Shiva only

8. Which stories are told about Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. That it is a harvest festival of Kenya
   B. That it is a Jain festival of forgiveness
   C. That it is the night of Shiva and Parvati's wedding or of Shiva's great dance
   D. That it is the birth of the Buddha

9. What is the holy scripture of the Sikhs? (1 mark)
   A. Dhammapada
   B. Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji
   C. Ramayan
   D. Kalpasutra

10. What is Madaraka Day? (1 mark)
   A. A Jain festival
   B. A Hindu festival
   C. A sports day
   D. A Kenyan national holiday on 1 June

11. Who declared that Sikhs should follow the Granth as their Guru? (1 mark)
   A. Ram
   B. Guru Amar Das Ji
   C. Guru Gobind Singh Ji
   D. Sigala

12. Which Jain scripture gives advice on a disciplined life? (1 mark)
   A. Dhammapada
   B. Ramayan
   C. Sigalovada Sutta
   D. Uttaradhyayan Sutra

13. What should you practise yoga on? (1 mark)
   A. A tree
   B. A mat
   C. A wet floor
   D. A road

14. What is a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A Hindu place of worship
   C. A school
   D. A market

15. What does graha mean in this tradition? (1 mark)
   A. A heavenly body
   B. A river
   C. A house
   D. A festival

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write a weekly plan using English and Indian day names with one activity for each of three days. (5 marks)

17. Match each being with a teaching: Narsimha, Parshvanath, Buddha, Guru Ram Das Ji. (4 marks)

18. Give three uses of the Indian traditional calendar. (3 marks)

19. State three contributions of Sri Guru Ram Das Ji. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — A man's body with a lion's head and claws
   He is shown as a man-lion.

2. B — Listen carefully and behave politely
   We show respect to all faiths.

3. B — Lake Victoria
   Lake Victoria is in Kenya; the other three are in India.

4. B — Goddess of knowledge and learning
   Saraswati is the goddess of learning.

5. D — Tea for coughs and colds
   Tulsi leaves are used in home medicine such as tea.

6. D — To avoid strain from wrong posture
   Experts correct mistakes.

7. A — Lord Vishnu and Lord Krishna
   Tulsi leaves are offered to Vishnu and Krishna.

8. C — That it is the night of Shiva and Parvati's wedding or of Shiva's great dance
   Different stories are told.

9. B — Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji
   Sikhs follow it as their eternal Guru.

10. D — A Kenyan national holiday on 1 June
   It celebrates self-government.

11. C — Guru Gobind Singh Ji
   He was the tenth Guru.

12. D — Uttaradhyayan Sutra
   It teaches Ahimsa, truth and control of anger.

13. B — A mat
   A clean mat is best.

14. B — A Hindu place of worship
   A Mandir is a Hindu temple.

15. A — A heavenly body
   Graha is a heavenly body.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any correct plan, for example Somvaar: help at home; Guruvaar: thank a teacher; Shukravaar: share with a friend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the format and 1 mark each for three correct day names with activities.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Narsimha: God protects the good. Parshvanath: Ahimsa. Buddha: kindness to the hurt. Guru Ram Das Ji: honest work, equality and service.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fixing festival dates, choosing days for prayers and family events, keeping tradition alive (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: He started the city of Amritsar and the Sarovar, composed hymns and the Laavan, and taught equality and service.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each contribution.
